title: 冠詞：職業名稱前要加 a/an
prompt: Fix this sentence: I am software engineer.

title: 頻率：N times a week

title: Vocabulary: reliable
answer: I am reliable at work because I always finish my tasks on time.

title: Speaking: describe your personality
prompt: How would you describe your personality? Answer in 3-5 sentences.
answer: Use at least three adjectives and one reason with because.

title: 句型：by + V-ing
prompt: Fix this sentence: I unwind by watch Netflix.

title: Speaking: typical weekday
prompt: Describe your typical weekday in 4-6 sentences.
answer: Use sequence words: first, then, after lunch, after work.

title: Vocabulary: cuisine vs dish
prompt: Explain the difference between cuisine and dish, then make one sentence with each.
answer: Cuisine means a style of cooking, such as Japanese cuisine. A dish means one prepared food, such as beef noodle soup.

title: 句型：taste + adjective
prompt: Fix this sentence: This soup is sour taste.

title: 句型：I'd like...
answer: I'd like a combo meal with a burger, fries, and a soft drink, please.

title: 句型：recommend + noun
prompt: Fix this sentence: I recommend you this dish.
answer: I recommend this dish. / I recommend the grilled chicken.

title: Speaking: ask about allergies
prompt: Ask whether a dish has peanuts and explain your allergy.
answer: Does this dish have peanuts? I have a peanut allergy.

title: Speaking: fast food opinion
prompt: Is fast food good or bad? Answer with one opinion, one reason, and one example.
answer: In my opinion, fast food is convenient but unhealthy if we eat it too often. For example, burgers and fries are often high in fat and salt.
